questions.text: What are the primary data sources this application consumes?
questions.context: Understanding source systems helps map the data dependency graph

questions.text: How is data ingested into this application (batch, real-time, API, manual upload)?
questions.context: Ingestion patterns reveal architecture maturity and potential bottlenecks

questions.text: What other systems does this application send data to?
questions.context: Downstream dependencies affect change impact and risk

questions.text: Are there any direct application-to-application data dependencies?
questions.context: Direct dependencies violate the lakehouse-as-hub principle

questions.text: What data quality checks or validation rules are in place?
questions.context: Data quality controls indicate governance maturity

questions.text: Who is responsible for data quality in this application?
questions.context: Ownership clarity is critical for governance

questions.text: What would break if this application went down for 24 hours?
questions.context: Reveals critical dependencies and SLA exposure

questions.text: What are the biggest data-related pain points with this application?
questions.context: Pain points often reveal architectural gaps

questions.text: Are there any planned changes to how this application handles data?
questions.context: Future state affects recommendations and sequencing

questions.text: How is sensitive or PII data handled within this application?
